title: What the Budget and Legislative Analyst found on police overtime and the police agreement
question: What has an official reviewer found about overtime paid under the Police Officers' Association agreement?
finding: The Budget and Legislative Analyst's audit of December 2024 found “approximately 51,000 ineligible 10B overtime hours were worked by employees with high sick leave usage between 2020 and 2023”, and that “SFPD has not adhered to key provisions of the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Police Officers’ Association related to sick leave”. In fiscal 2026 the unit was paid $156.8 million of overtime, 47.1% of its regular pay.
how: Quotations from the audit text on disk (checked word for word); the fiscal 2026 figure is the first table on this page.
limits: The audit covers fiscal 2018-19 to 2022-23 and a sample of records; 10B overtime is paid back by the outside bodies that hire officers, and the department answered the audit's recommendations. The terms on mandatory overtime are negotiated provisions.

rows.said: The Police Department did not enforce the sick-leave terms of its agreement with the Police Officers’ Association that decide who may work voluntary 10B overtime.
